# waldur_project_permission (Resource)

Project Permission resource



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project` (String) UUID of the project
- `role` (String) Role name (e.g. PROJECT.ADMIN, PROJECT.MANAGER, PROJECT.MEMBER)
- `user` (String) UUID of the user

### Optional

- `expiration_time` (String) Expiration time of the role (RFC3339 format or null)
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Project Permission UUID (used as Terraform ID)
